name: Lord Mahavira
majorContributions: Systematized the Five Great Vows (Mahavratas)
Established the Sravaka-Shravika tradition for laypeople
Revealed the doctrine of Anekantavada (non-absolutism)
Compiled canonical teachings through 11 Ganadharas
Founded the four-fold Sangha (monks, nuns, laymen, laywomen)
Attained Kevala Jnana after 12 years of intense Tapa
Delivered 34 final sermons (Uttaradhyayana Sutra)
legacyQuotes: Ahimsa Paramo Dharma — Non-violence is the highest religion.
Live and let live.
The soul is neither born nor does it die. It is eternal.

name: Ganadhar Gautama Swami
majorContributions: First disciple (Ganadhar) of Lord Mahavira
Chief interpreter of Mahavira's teachings
Compiled Mahavira's sermons into structured Agamas
Led the 11 Ganadharas who preserved the canon
Attained Kevala Jnana through boundless reverence for Mahavira
legacyQuotes: O Omniscient One, I bow to you.

name: Acharya Bhadrabahu
majorContributions: Last Shrutakevalin (knower of all 14 Purvas)
Led migration of Jain sangha to South India during famine
Authored Kalpa Sutra (monastic codes)
Wrote Brihat Kalpa Sutra on monastic rules
Composed Svetambara and Digambara canonical traditions
legacyQuotes: The Sangha follows the teacher wherever the truth leads.

name: Acharya Kundakunda
majorContributions: Developed the distinction between Nishchaya (absolute) and Vyavahara (practical) truth
Revealed that the soul is both omniscient (from absolute view) and embodied (from practical view)
Authored the most foundational Digambara texts of self-realization
His works form the core of Digambara spiritual practice today
legacyQuotes: From the real standpoint, the self is the knower, the doer, and the enjoyer.

name: Acharya Umaswati
majorContributions: Authored the Tattvartha Sutra — the most comprehensive summary of all Jain philosophy
Unified Svetambara and Digambara perspectives on core tattvas
Wrote in elegant Sanskrit sutras that are memorized and recited globally
Provided the standard framework for all advanced Jain study
legacyQuotes: Right faith, right knowledge, right conduct — this is the path to liberation.

name: Acharya Samantabhadra
majorContributions: Authored Aptamimansa establishing Anekantavada through logical proof
Revealed the nature of the Omniscient Teacher (Apta) using pramana and naya
Wrote Ratnakarandaka Shravakachara for lay ethical conduct
Advanced Jain logic beyond the Nyaya school
legacyQuotes: The omniscient teacher is revealed through logic.

name: Acharya Pujyapada
majorContributions: Authored Sarvarthasiddhi — the premier Sanskrit commentary on Tattvartha Sutra
Systematized the epistemological framework of Jainism
Treated the distinctions between Svetambara and Digambara with scholarly precision
His commentary is studied in all Jain universities
legacyQuotes: Even a little dharma saves from great fear.

name: Acharya Hemchandracharya
majorContributions: Universal genius — wrote 3 crore verses according to legend
Authored Yoga Shastra — the most comprehensive Jain yoga manual
Systematized Prakrit grammar and lexicography
Served as spiritual guide to King Kumarapala, making Gujarat a Jain center
Composed monumental works on logic, grammar, history, and yoga
legacyQuotes: Beauty without virtue is like a flower without fragrance.

name: Acharya Vidyasagar ji
majorContributions: Leading Digambara monk of modern times
Revitalized ancient monastic practices across India
Built thousands of temples, schools, and hospitals
Composed modern Sanskrit verses and spiritual guidance
Influenced millions through pravachanas worldwide
legacyQuotes: Live like a monk even in the marketplace.

name: Acharya Amar Muni
majorContributions: Author of the most widely read Hindi commentary on Agamas
Translated and explained complex Prakrit sutras for modern lay readers
Composed accessible spiritual literature for children and adults
Established religious education programs across Gujarat
legacyQuotes: Study, meditate, and purify — this is the threefold path.

name: Acharya Tulsi
majorContributions: Founded the Anuvrata movement for lay spiritual revival
Created the Jain Vishva Bharati university
Authored the 'Jain Yoga' and 'Anuvrata' literature
Introduced 'preksha meditation' systematically
Bridged ancient wisdom with modern psychology and sociology
legacyQuotes: Small vows lead to great victories.

name: Acharya Mahapragya
majorContributions: Disciplined successor of Acharya Tulsi
Expanded Preksha Meditation globally
Authored extensive philosophical works
Advanced Jain logic through modern academic research
Pioneered interfaith dialogue while maintaining doctrinal purity
legacyQuotes: Peace begins within the individual.

name: Jinendra Varni
majorContributions: Compiled Saman Suttam — the universally accepted synthesis scripture of all Jain traditions
Gathered verses from across Svetambara and Digambara Agamas
Made canonical texts accessible through critical compilation
Bridged sectarian divides through shared literature
legacyQuotes: All Jains are one in the essential teachings.

name: Hermann Jacobi
majorContributions: Pioneered Western academic study of Jainism
Translated key Agamas into English (Sacred Books of the East series)
Brought Jain philosophy to European universities
Established Jainism as a world religion alongside Buddhism and Hinduism
His translations remain the standard English reference
works: Jainism in Encyclopedia of Religion and Ethics
legacyQuotes: Jainism is not a primitive religion but the most systematic ancient philosophy.

name: Nathmal Tatia
majorContributions: Translated Tattvartha Sutra into English (2005) with masterful commentary
Translated Sarvarthasiddhi — the standard commentary on Tattvartha
Advanced academic understanding of Jain epistemology at University of Rajasthan
Made complex Prakrit texts accessible to English-speaking scholars
legacyQuotes: The Tattvartha Sutra contains in 350 verses the entire philosophy of life.

name: Acharya Vardhamana Suriji (Acharya Kundakunda lineage)
majorContributions: Revived Digambara monasticism in North India
Established rigorous training for Digambara monks
Composed spiritual literature and pravachanas on Samayasara
Emphasized Nishchaya (absolute) view of soul over Vyavahara (practical)
legacyQuotes: The soul is pure. Only ignorance obscures it.

name: Acharya Rajendrasuri
majorContributions: Reformed the Svetambara monastic order
Established the Agamic publication society for scripture preservation
Authored Abhidhan Bhandara (massive Jain lexicon)
Systematized tapas and scriptural study for monks
Founded educational institutions for Jain youth
legacyQuotes: Discipline without learning is faith without understanding.

name: Acharya Vidyananda ji
majorContributions: Oversaw the compilation of Saman Suttam under Jinendra Varni
Advanced scholarly understanding of canonical texts
Pravachanas across India emphasizing Anekantavada in modern context
Worked for inter-sect harmony while preserving tradition
legacyQuotes: The truth is one; it manifests in many forms.

name: Acharya Shantisagar
majorContributions: Revived ancient Digambara practices
Traveled across India barefoot for 50+ years
Founded Digambara institutions
Emphasized strict adherence to Mahavratas
legacyQuotes: The road to liberation is traveled on bare feet.
